notes: Sides: 3-5 px inside the thin rule that runs just inside the thick bar (here only a 1-2 px white hairline separates them). The frame bows (top rule steps down ~11 px between x 1120 and 1360; right rule drifts ~13 px inward from top to bottom), so points were set along every side from the rule measured on full-resolution crops and pixel profiles. Corners (README rule 2): the outline follows ~4 px inside the inner edge of the innermost arc (TL and BL have a separate thin arc inside the thick one; at TR and BR they merge), so the arcs and corner triangles are outside. Map ink on the left (blocks west of the Embarcadero side) runs into the left rule and across the bottom-left arc; the edge keeps the rule outside and cuts those blocks at the arc. Holes (README rule 4): the CITY & COUNTY ... ZONE MAP title/legend/scale block (top right, open bay paper around it, rectangle), the SECTION 8 badge (octagon, kept clear of the top-right arc), the compass rose with its two long arrows (elongated outline along the arrows; clear of the C and O of BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO), and the 'Join Sec. 9' cross-reference (inside the frame, diagonal outline; hole edge on paper). 'Join Sec. 1' and 'Join Sec. 7' print outside the frame. Kept as map: BAY OF SAN FRANCISCO, pier and pier-head lettering, and the dotted box round Mission Rock (a real island, drawn with its zoning).
